message:
1 string literals reach the DOM through a name the template binds:
      libs/components/widget/src/widget.html:37: interpolation reads `label` → "Delete the row"
description: A sentence an inline outlet's context hands a listbox's row, whose other variable an element reads (`[attr.aria-posinset]="i + 1"`). A template's variable stands for the literals it is handed and for no template: the outlet names the template beside the context, and a variable standing for it made the row's element one more node handing the template, its `class` and `role` two more refusals.
